summary: Frontend-only testing of /inscricao.html password fields feature. Verified initial disabled state, password match enables Continue button, password mismatch disables + shows error, and password eye toggles work without altering values.

test_results.test_2_passwords_match_enables_button: PASS - With all required fields filled (used valid CEP 01001-000 for ViaCEP autofill of Endereço/Bairro/Cidade/UF), files uploaded, checkbox checked, and SENHA_CAD=SENHA_CONF='abc123' → #btn-salvar.disabled=false and #SENHA_ERR display=none
test_results.test_3_passwords_mismatch_disables_and_s: PASS - SENHA_CAD='abc123', SENHA_CONF='zzz999' → #btn-salvar.disabled=true and #SENHA_ERR display=block with text 'As senhas não coincidem'
test_results.test_4_eye_toggle_SENHA_CAD: PASS - Clicking .senha-eye[data-target=SENHA_CAD] toggles input type password↔text; value 'abc123' preserved (no uppercase, no clearing) thanks to data-noupper='1'

critical_code_review_comments: ViaCEP autofill: when CEP is not found (e.g., 57000-000), the handler clears LOGRADOURO/BAIRRO/CIDADE/UF fields even if the user typed values before the async response returned. This causes user input loss and could confuse users filling from top-to-bottom. Consider only clearing when fields were auto-populated (add a flag), or skip clearing if user already typed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testing used CEP '01001-000' (São Paulo) which triggers ViaCEP successful autocomplete populating LOGRADOURO/BAIRRO/CIDADE/UF. Do NOT use '57000-000' first because ViaCEP returns not-found and the handler wipes the address fields you typed. Required fields on the page: NOME (name attr only, no id), CPF, DATA_NASCIMENTO, SEXO, CEP, LOGRADOURO, NUMERO, BAIRRO, CIDADE, UF, CELULAR, EMAIL, SENHA_CAD, SENHA_CONF, DOC_TIPO, DOC_FRENTE (file), DOC_VERSO (file), declaracao_veracidade (checkbox). SENHA_CAD/SENHA_CONF have data-noupper='1' so upcase behavior is disabled correctly.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in the tested password feature
